newsitem.title: USA: Digi Int'l launches new modem module.
newsitem.headline: Digi Int'l launches new modem module.

text.p: Digi International Inc said Wednesday it introduced its AccelePort Modem/Xem, which is designed to help users add dedicated data/fax modems to Digi's expandable serial computer systems.
The company said the new product streamlines remote access service configurations by eliminating the need for external modems, power supplies and cables for each device.
The AccelePort Modem/Xem has a list price of $1,995 and will be available in the United States and Canada, Digi said.
Digi makes data communications hardware and software.
Its shares were unchanged Wednesday at 8-1/4.
